{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("Number of unique patient_id:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total number of rows:", len(df))

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print("Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check assay_batch distribution
print("Assay batch distribution:", df['assay_batch'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Check sample_seq distribution per patient
print("Max sample_seq per patient:", df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().value_counts().to_dict())

# Check arm and severity distribution
print("Arm distribution:", df['arm'].value_counts().to_dict())
print("Severity distribution:", df['severity'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Check if any patient has multiple rows with sample_seq > 1
retested_patients = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max() > 1
print("Number of retested patients (sample_seq > 1):", retested_patients.sum())"}
